summary:
The patient's medical history begins prior to the motor vehicle accident at issue, with a September 3, 2022 gym weightlifting accident in which the patient sustained severe neck pain and stiffness during a heavy squat set (a discrepancy in the exact injury date was later noted in the records on 2022-09-10). Dr. Alistair Finch at Back & Spine Restoration Center evaluated the patient on September 12, 2022, diagnosing acute cervical strain with possible underlying cervical disc herniation or bulge, and noted the patient had prior treatment for cervicalgia earlier in 2022. A three-view cervical spine X-ray on September 15, 2022 showed mild degenerative disc disease at C5-C6 with a 4mm posterior disc bulge — a finding later characterized by both Dr. Elizabeth Foster and Dr. Myrtle Turner as a pre-existing condition predating the subsequent motor vehicle accident.

The motor vehicle accident occurred on or about September 4, 2023, resulting in left arm fractures requiring emergency care at Littel Inc Emergency Hospital. Dr. Elizabeth Foster performed surgical procedures on the left arm fractures that day, with a nerve block tray administered for anesthesia; a CT scan of the head without contrast followed on September 5, 2023, and fluoroscopic imaging was used intraoperatively on September 7, 2023, under Dr. Myrtle Turner to confirm anatomic alignment and hardware placement for open reduction and internal fixation of the left humerus and radius. Acetaminophen 975mg was administered September 6, 2023 for pain control.

Diagnoses following surgery included post-surgical left humerus and radius ORIF, cervicalgia, and left knee contusion. Physical therapy began September 15, 2023 at Lang-Weimann Medical Center under Robert Stewart, continuing through December 11, 2023 for a total of 30 sessions, addressing left upper extremity mobilization and cervical symptoms, which were repeatedly provoked during treatment. Medications included Oxycodone-Acetaminophen 5-325mg, Cyclobenzaprine 10mg (started October 19, 2023), and high-dose Ibuprofen 800mg (started November 16, 2023). A significant treatment gap occurred between November 14 and November 21, 2023, when the patient missed three consecutive PT appointments, resulting in rebounded left elbow stiffness noted November 24, 2023. Follow-up imaging on December 14, 2023 showed well-healed fractures with stable hardware, though an MRI of the left upper extremity and C-spine was ordered for persistent restrictions and decreased radial sensation.

Care transitioned to Emory Sports Medicine Complex under Amanda Gregory on January 8, 2024, continuing through discharge on March 22, 2024, comprising another 30 sessions. On March 25, 2024, the patient was noted to have achieved substantial improvement but retained a persistent 15-degree extension deficit in the left elbow and chronic pain, representing the patient's current documented status.
